document.pages: PDF p.28 — Spring return pushbuttons (unmarked): Heads only / Flush selection table, Yellow = ZB4BA5

modelingNotes: ZB4BA5 is the head only (mechanical operator/actuator). Same catalog identity.

Catalog p.28, visually inspected: 'Heads only / Flush' lists Yellow = ZB4BA5 (weight 0.029/0.064 kg/lb) with no NO/NC contact columns. The complete yellow unit XB4BA51 = ZB4BZ101 (1 NO contact block) + ZB4BA5 head, proving the head carries no contacts. Note (1): the contacts constitute the separately ordered body (fixing collar + contact).

Characteristics (se.com ZB4BA5 product page): metal, flush, Ø22 (22 mm), spring return (momentary), unmarked. It requires a separately ordered contact-block body; connection technologies (screw clamp / connector / Faston / spring terminal) belong to that body, not the head.

No electrical terminals, contacts, LEDs or PE terminal are asserted for this head. Contact and LED membership belong to the separately ordered body; a metal bezel/collar outline does not prove an installed panel bond. Zero-terminal mechanical item modeled as a documentation/accessory view — no wiring, fixed links or nets.

connectionCoverage.notes: Head-only mechanical actuator with zero electrical terminals. Contacts are not part of this reference; they constitute the separately ordered body (fixing collar + contact block) per catalog note (1). The metal bezel/fixing collar may provide a panel-earth bond once assembled, but no bonding terminal is documented for the head, so that interface remains unresolved.
